12/G.goal: Explain how cybersickness is evaluated and mitigated in XR systems, using machine-learning-based detection or prediction methods and developer- or user-side countermeasures that balance presence.
12/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for addressing a key psycho-physiological issue in XR, so they can choose sickness-evaluation methods and apply countermeasures with confidence when understanding or implementing XR systems.

12/O1.goal: Explain how machine-learning-based cybersickness evaluation methods are characterized by their task, output type, and model interpretability.
12/O1.achieves: It lets the learner understand what sickness-monitoring options are available when evaluating or developing an XR system and how to interpret their results.

12/O2.goal: Explain how cybersickness is mitigated in XR by balancing presence against comfort, including developer-side and user-side countermeasures.
12/O2.achieves: It lets the learner reduce cybersickness in XR use or design by selecting appropriate technical or user-centered measures while understanding their effect on presence.
